v.s: Woe to those who give less [than due],
v.c: Woe to the defrauders!
v.h: Warning to Those Who Cheat Others

q: ...who, when they take measure from mankind
(that their goods be given to them)
(They ensure that the seller does not weigh or measure less than what they are paying.)
v.s: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
v.c: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,

q: If they measure or weigh for people
(the weight or measurement of the commodity so that the buyer gets less than what he pays.)
v.s: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
v.c: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.

q: Do such people not consider that
v.s: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
v.c: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

v.s: For a tremendous Day -
v.c: for a tremendous Day —

q: ...the day when all of mankind will stand before the Rabb of the universe
(to account for their actions and words)?
v.s: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
v.c: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?

q: (It shall never be as they think that Qiyaamah will not come!)
(a place of punishment beneath the seven earths, where the records of Kuffaar are placed).
v.s: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
v.c: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—

q: How will you know what is
v.s: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
v.c: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

q: (which cannot be changed in any way).
v.s: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
v.c: a fate ˹already˺ sealed.

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

v.s: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
v.c: those who deny Judgment Day!

q: It is only every sinful transgressor
v.s: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
v.c: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.

q: When Our Aayaat are recited to him, he says,
v.s: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
v.c: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

q: (These are not fables, but the absolute truth!)
(so that no truth can penetrate it).
v.s: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
v.c: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!

q: (What they say cannot be true!) (As a result of their rejection)
v.s: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
v.c: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.

v.s: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
v.c: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,

q: is what you used to deny
v.s: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
v.c: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

q: (as the Kuffaar say that the Mu'mineen will be deprived of rewards)!
Verily the records of the righteous
(a place of bliss in the seventh heaven where the records of the sincere Mu'mineen are placed).
v.s: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
v.c: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—

q: How will you know what is
v.s: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
v.c: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

v.s: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
v.c: a fate ˹already˺ sealed,

v.s: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to God].
v.c: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.

v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
v.c: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,

v.s: On adorned couches, observing.
v.c: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.

q: You will recognise the radiance of bounties on their faces
v.s: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
v.c: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.

m: They will be given to drink
q: They will be given pure sealed
(completely unlike the impure and intoxicating wine of this world)...
v.s: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
v.c: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,

q: ...the seal of which is musk. It is for this that competitors
(instead of competing for the inferior things of this world).
v.s: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
v.c: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.

q: Its mixture shall be of Tasneem...
v.s: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
v.c: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

q: from which those close to Allaah drink.
v.s: A spring from which those near [to God] drink.
v.c: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.

q: used to laugh at the Mu'mineen
v.s: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
v.c: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,

q: used to wink at each other
v.s: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
v.c: wink to one another whenever they passed by,

q: returned to their families, they would return
(the Mu'mineen, unrepentant for jeering at the Mu'mineen earlier).
v.s: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
v.c: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.

q: they used to say, “These people are certainly astray.”
v.s: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
v.c: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”

q: (the Mu'mineen). (Therefore, instead of ridiculing the Mu'mineen, the Kuffaar ought to worry instead about themselves.)
v.s: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
v.c: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.

q: the Mu'mineen shall laugh at the Kuffaar
(because the truth will be made apparent and the Mu'mineen will be in a superior position)...
v.s: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
v.c: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,

v.s: On adorned couches, observing.
v.c: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.

q: from being an act of oppression against the Kuffaar,)
The fact is that the Kuffaar are being punished
(they will be treated just as they had treated others).
v.s: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
v.c: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
